about: One engine per mechanic: every source file belongs to one engine family, and a file of one family reaches another family only through that family's entry files (its src/core2/modules file, or the folder's index). Paths are globs from the repository root; ** crosses folders, * does not. shared is the kernel every family may import. .github/CODEOWNERS is written from this file (scripts/guards/codeowners.ts); protected lists the instructions, workflows, guards and baselines the owner reviews, which are not a family. The guard is tests/guards/families.test.ts; docs/design/guards.md explains it.
